review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked where LoopDensity.Plane (Fin 2 → ℝ), augment, baseAngle, arcX and blendedAngle are defined. The file has one definition, blendedPath, which is the angle-to-unit-vector map ![cos θ, sin θ] composed with blendedAngle at 2πt. It is a specific parametrization of a loop in the Plane type used by LoopDensity, and the loop-density API takes plane-valued paths. I found no Mathlib definition that is the same concept under the same assumptions and would remove conversions. Candidates such as Circle.exp, Complex.exp and EuclideanSpace alternatives would add conversions to Fin 2 → ℝ. The remaining declarations are lemmas, which are out of scope. I did not exhaustively search Mathlib for every possible competing structure. The case for consolidation is unclear, so I abstain.
